summary:
• Clarifies connection errors and preserves useful operation context.
• Improves Identity Review diagnostics and distinguishes unknown facts from confirmed conflicts.
• Tightens Popular maps spacing and renames the section to Top 5.
• Strengthens protection of existing maps during Update.
• Improves Update and Remove results across Garmin session changes.
• Reads installed-map information using current device identities.
• Preserves confirmed external Remove after app reinstall or on another Mac.
